helpRequestShareText: Can you help me with this Meowtrix puzzle?
helpAnswerShareText: Here is my progress on your Meowtrix puzzle.
helpInvitation: Your friend is solving this puzzle. Would you like to join?
helpAnswerPartial: A friend shared their progress. Would you like to see it?
helpAnswerComplete: A friend solved this puzzle. Would you like to see it?
helpOwnHintsNotice: This is a separate game with no personal rewards. Hints use your own balance.
helpPreviewNotice: Preview first. Your board changes only when you apply it.
helpReplaceWarning: Applying replaces the entire board. The previous board cannot be restored.
helpUnavailableCompleted: You already completed this puzzle. You can still view your friend’s answer.
helpUnavailableRestarted: You restarted this puzzle. This answer cannot be applied, but you can view it separately.
helpUnavailableExpired: This Daily Challenge has ended. You can view the answer separately.
helpLinkInvalid: This sharing link is invalid. Please ask your friend to share it again.
helpLinkIncompatible: This puzzle is not supported by this version. Update the game and open the link again.
helpDownloadNotice: After installing, tap the original sharing link again. If opening is blocked, use Safari or the Open button in its app banner.
